speaker: traveller
text: Nearly midnight. The forest goes quiet here.

speaker: traveller
text: A bell. There is no one out here.

speaker: traveller
text: So it is real.

speaker: traveller
text: The braziers are still burning. Someone keeps them.

speaker: traveller
text: The roof has fallen in places. Moonlight gets through.

speaker: traveller
text: A single tusk. And a warrior with an axe.

speaker: traveller
text: My lantern—

speaker: traveller
text: …and a lamp I did not light.

speaker: traveller
text: The lamps lead somewhere.

speaker: temple
text: What is remembered here is not lost. Under the moon, touch, and know.

speaker: traveller
text: The stone is warm.

speaker: temple
text: A gateway on the mountain. A warrior who will not be refused. Hold.

speaker: temple
text: Not every blow must be answered.

speaker: traveller
text: The passage. It was sealed before.

speaker: temple
text: The temple remembers what you allowed.

speaker: traveller
text: This room… I have been in this room already.

speaker: temple
text: What envies the real cannot bear the light.

speaker: traveller
text: Open to the sky. The whole chamber is waiting for the moon.

speaker: temple
text: In shadow, other doors.

speaker: traveller
text: The carving goes all the way around. It is moving.

speaker: traveller
text: It was guarding this. Not hunting me.

speaker: temple
text: Understand each line before you write it.

speaker: temple
text: Here it feeds. Here it is named: the Forgetting.

speaker: traveller
text: Untouched. All this time.

speaker: temple
text: Place each memory where it belongs.

speaker: narration
text: At sunrise, the temple was not dead. It was kept.

speaker: narration
text: Shrine lit. You can return here from the map.

speaker: temple
text: The order is written elsewhere. Look again.

speaker: traveller
text: Too dark to tell what is real. The lamps in the hall—

speaker: temple
text: Three stand before you. Two are envy's copies. Touch the one that holds.

speaker: temple
text: It takes what it cannot have. Give the fires back their light.

speaker: temple
text: Denied, it rages. Do not answer it. Step aside; leap the ground it shakes.

speaker: temple
text: It kneels. Release it; envy unmade is not an enemy.

speaker: traveller
text: The passage is itself again. The memories here are being changed on purpose.

speaker: temple
text: The lens is full. Now wait for the shadow.

speaker: traveller
text: A wheel. The whole roof moves with it.

speaker: temple
text: Run.

speaker: traveller
text: One fragment is missing from its place.

speaker: traveller
text: Here. The missing piece.

speaker: temple
text: Now the line can be read as one.

speaker: temple
text: Not yet. What feeds here can only be named by one who has seen every memory.

speaker: temple
text: Here it feeds. It has no story of its own: only what it takes. Name it: the Forgetting.

speaker: temple
text: It has hidden the moon. Press the three marks it tried to erase.

speaker: temple
text: Moonlight. It cannot hold what is remembered in the light.

speaker: temple
text: It thrashes. Step aside. Leap the ground.

speaker: temple
text: It is small now. Restore the altar.

speaker: traveller
text: Quiet. The sanctum door is open.

speaker: temple
text: Six memories, in the order the temple learned them.
